identity.name: Top Time Limited Edition
identity.one_liner: A 2,000-piece 2020 reissue of the 1960s Top Time 'Zorro' dial, discontinued after its limited run.

provenance_events.description: The screen-used 1962 Breitling Top Time worn by Sean Connery as James Bond in Thunderball (1965) — modified with a fictional Geiger counter for the plot — sells at Christie's London for $160,175 against a $60,500-$90,750 estimate, after being found years earlier at a UK car-boot sale for about £25. It is the only Breitling worn on-screen by a Bond actor.

narrative.story: The original Breitling Top Time launched in 1964 as an accessible chronograph; a variant with counter-shaded subdial rims on its Ref. 2002 dial earned the collector nickname "Zorro" for the diagonal mask-like shading. A modified 1962 Top Time, worn on-screen by Sean Connery as James Bond in Thunderball, later sold at Christie's for over $160,000. Breitling reissued the Zorro dial in 2020 as a numbered edition of 2,000 pieces, then discontinued it.
narrative.collector_notes: This is a sold-out numbered limited edition with no current-catalog equivalent; confirm the individual number and any certificate against the box set when buying pre-owned, since it no longer appears on breitling.com.
